_comment: IMA Energy Atlas - map view configuration. The illustrator fills in the visual SVG; this file specifies the structural data the map binds to.

canvas._note: Top half (y < 450) is ocean. Bottom half is the island. Coastline runs roughly along y=420-460 with irregular bay/inlet shapes. Adjust as the illustration develops, but keep the ocean/island split.

districts.label: Open Ocean
districts._position_note: Upper left of canvas. Deep water. Drilling rigs and OFS vessels scattered across this area; tankers cluster toward the right side approaching port.

districts.label: Port / Industrial Waterfront
districts._position_note: Right side of canvas, straddling the coastline. LNG export terminals at the actual water's edge, refineries and petrochem plants set back slightly. Cranes, tank farms, jetties.

districts.label: Industrial Inland
districts._position_note: Just inland from the port. Pipeline corridors radiating outward. IOC corporate campuses (taller buildings, but minimal - these are just headquarters). Gathering & processing plants nearer the basin.

districts.label: Oilfield / Basin
districts._position_note: The largest district - sprawling sepia-toned oilfield occupying the center and lower-left of the island. Pump jacks, rigs, well pads. This is where most of the visual weight goes.

districts.label: Equipment Yards
districts._position_note: Small district between the basin and the port. Rows of stacked pipe, drilling rigs in storage, fabrication shops. Industrial but smaller scale than the port.

districts.label: Quarry / Mine
districts._position_note: Lower-left corner. Open-pit mine with terraced walls. Conveyor belts. A quieter, darker district - coal and minerals are extractive but lower-vol than oil.

districts.label: Farmland Edge
districts._position_note: Thin strip along the bottom of the basin. Cornfields with a small ethanol plant. Muted greens.

districts.label: Power District
districts._position_note: Lower-right of island. A grouping: gas-fired power station (cooling towers), wind turbines on a ridge, transmission lines radiating. Distinct from the industrial port - this is where electricity is GENERATED, not consumed.

districts.label: Nuclear Quarter
districts._position_note: Adjacent to the power district but visually separated - its own enclave with cooling towers (the canonical nuclear silhouette). Smaller, fewer elements, more iconic.

districts.label: Town
districts._position_note: Small clustered town - a few buildings, a gas station icon, maybe a road running through. The 'consumer' end of the value chain. Smallest district by visual weight.

_district_layout_summary: Ocean (top half): open_ocean spans most of the upper area
Coastline runs y=420-460, with port_waterfront protruding into the water on the right
Island (bottom half) districts, roughly clockwise from upper-right:

edges._note: Three toggleable edge modes. 'flow' is hand-specified commodity flow direction. 'correlation' is data-driven (computed at runtime from cross_basket_correlation.csv). 'signal' is data-driven (active pairs from pairs_table.csv where |z|>1.5).
edges._correlation_mode: Computed at page load from cross_basket_correlation.csv. Edge between two districts whose AVERAGE constituent-node correlation > 0.5. Thickness = correlation strength.
edges._signal_mode: Computed at page load from pairs_table.csv. Edge between two districts wherever an active taxonomy-driven pair has |z_60d| > 1.5. Color: red for negative z, green for positive z.

edge_modes.label: Commodity Flow
edge_modes.description: Directed edges show physical commodity movement through the value chain. Static.

edge_modes.label: Correlation
edge_modes.description: Edge thickness encodes pairwise district correlation over the lookback window.

edge_modes.label: Active Signals
edge_modes.description: Highlights pairs currently stretched (|z|>1.5). Updates with each data refresh.

click_district.behavior: If district has 1 node, open that node's drawer directly. If district has multiple nodes, show a small picker (or open the first node by default and let user navigate within drawer).

click_node_marker.behavior: Open the corresponding node's drawer. Marker is a small clickable visual element (e.g. a derrick icon for an E&P node within the oilfield district).

hover_node_marker.behavior: Highlight the marker, dim others. Show tooltip with display_name, representative_ticker, R², dominant driver. Highlight any edges connected to this node's district.

node_marker_count_per_district._note: How many distinct visual elements should represent the sub-industries within each district. Some districts have multiple nodes - the illustrator can either render one element per node OR render thematic clusters (e.g. 'a row of pump jacks' represents the oil_eandp node).
node_marker_count_per_district.open_ocean: 3 elements: a drillship (drillers), a smaller subsea vessel (OFS offshore), a tanker (shipping)
node_marker_count_per_district.port_waterfront: 3 elements: LNG storage tanks with jetty (LNG terminals), a refinery silhouette (refiners), a chemical plant with stacks (petrochem)
node_marker_count_per_district.industrial_inland: 3 elements: a pipeline pump station (pipelines), a gas processing facility (GPT), a corporate tower or two (IOCs)
node_marker_count_per_district.oilfield_basin: Treat as a sprawling region; multiple pump jacks scattered (oil E&P primarily), a few drilling rigs (gas E&P), a service yard (OFS onshore), and a small surveyor's mark or property line motif (minerals/royalty)
node_marker_count_per_district.equipment_yards: 1-2 elements: stacked drill pipe, fabrication shed
node_marker_count_per_district.farmland_edge: 1 element: corn rows + small ethanol plant
node_marker_count_per_district.power_district: 4 elements: gas plant cooling towers (regulated gas), wind turbines on a ridge (renewables), transmission tower (IPPs), small distribution station (LDC)
node_marker_count_per_district.nuclear_quarter: 2 elements: classic nuclear cooling towers (uranium fuel), a small modular reactor cylinder (SMR)

atmospheric_palette._note: Restrained, desaturated. Each district's fill color is one of these. Background remains the existing very-dark base.
